What Mercor sells

  • Human data & evals: Expert-authored training data and evaluations.
  • APEX Benchmarks: Tests of professional work, with task datasets for AI agents.
  • APEX-Agents: Tests extended professional work across several applications.
  • APEX-Accounting: Tests accounting work across applications. Developed with Ramp.
  • APEX-SWE: Tests software integration and observability (checking what software does while it runs). Developed with Cognition.
  • Enterprise AI: Builds AI agents for business tasks.
